description:
Andreas Behrendt – Technology & Practice
Welcome to my channel.
I’m Andreas Behrendt, a German master electrician living and working in Tenerife, Spain. I’ve always been interested in how things work – and in building, modifying, testing and sometimes fixing them myself.
Here you’ll find practical technology, real projects and hands-on experience:
⚙️ CNC & Machines
⛵ Boats & Marine
⚡ Electrical & Electronics
🔧 Workshop & Tools
🛠️ Projects & Practical Solutions
From CNC and workshop projects to boats, electrical systems, tools and technical experiments – I share what I build, what I learn and what sometimes goes wrong along the way.
No theory for theory’s sake. Just practical technology, real projects and hands-on experience.
🇩🇪 German | 🇬🇧 English | 🇪🇸 Tenerife, Spain
For my German-language channel about electrical technology in Spain, visit Andreas Behrendt – Elektrotechnik zwischen Deutschland und Spanien.
